description:
查询资产库。支持 DSL 表达式搜索、按 id/ids 直接取，分页。
DSL 语法：field=value 模糊(ILIKE) | field==value 精确 | field!=value 排除 | port>80 数字比较 | 裸词=全文模糊。
逻辑运算：AND / OR（关键字，AND 优先级高于 OR），括号分组。
资产类型用独立的 type 参数过滤，DSL 里不含 type 字段。
约束：未传 id/ids 时 dsl 必须非空——不允许无条件查询全部资产，必须带查询条件。
字段一览：
  domain      域名（根域名/子域名/服务域名）
  root_domain 根域名（仅子域名/服务资产有）
  ip          IPv4/IPv6 地址
  url         完整 URL（服务/接口）
  page_title  页面标题（HTTP 服务）
  icp         ICP 备案号（根域名）
  service_name 服务名称（非 HTTP 服务）
  app_name    应用名称（app 类型）
  method      HTTP 方法（接口类型，如 GET/POST）
  service_type HTTP 服务类型：http|other
  record_type DNS 解析类型（子域名，如 A/CNAME）
  technology  指纹/技术栈（数组字段，= 模糊 == 精确）
  port        端口号（整数，支持 > >= < <=）
  status_code HTTP 状态码（整数，支持 > >= < <=）
  company_id  归属企业 id（整数）
  task_id     来源任务 id（整数）
示例：status_code>=400 AND technology=shiro
      method==POST AND url=/api/admin
      icp=京 OR icp=沪
      (port==80 OR port==443) AND technology=nginx

dsl.description: DSL 查询表达式，参见工具描述。未传 id/ids 时必须非空。例：status_code>=400 technology=shiro / method==POST url=/api/admin

id.description: 直接按单个资产 id 取（可选，与 dsl/type 互斥）

ids.description: 直接按多个资产 id 取（可选，与 dsl/type 互斥）

type.description: 资产类型过滤：root_domain|ip|subdomain|app|service|endpoint（独立字段，可与 dsl 叠加；单独 type 不足以查询，仍需 dsl）

description:
Search for asset bank. Support DSL Organisation id/ids Directly, page break.
DSL Syntax:field=value Blur(ILIKE) | field==value Exact | field!=value Exclude | port>80 Number Comparison | Naked words.=The whole text is vague.
Logical operation:AND / OR(Keywords,AND Priority above OR),parenthesis grouping.
Use separate asset types type Parameter filter,DSL Not included type field.
Constraints: Unheard id/ids Time dsl It has to be empty.——Unconditional access to all assets is not allowed and must be conditional.
field:
  domain      Domain name (root domain / subdomain / service domain name)
  root_domain Root domain name (subdomain-only / service assets available)
  ip          IPv4/IPv6 Address
  url         Full URL (service / endpoint)
  page_title  Page title (HTTP services)
  icp         ICP registration number (root domain)
  service_name Name of the service (non-HTTP services)
  app_name    Application name (app type)
  method      HTTP method (endpoint type, e.g. GET/POST)
  service_type HTTP service type: http|other
  record_type DNS record type (subdomain name, such as A/CNAME)
  technology  Fingerprint / technology stack (numeric fields: = fuzzy, == exact)
  port        Port number (integer; supports > >= < <=)
  status_code HTTP status code (integer; supports > >= < <=)
  company_id  Owning company id (integer)
  task_id     Source task id (integer)
Example:status_code>=400 AND technology=shiro
      method==POST AND url=/api/admin
      icp=Beijing OR icp=Shanghai
      (port==80 OR port==443) AND technology=nginx

dsl.description: DSL query expression; see the tool description. Required when neither id nor ids is supplied. Example: status_code>=400 technology=shiro / method==POST url=/api/admin

id.description: Fetch a single asset directly by ID (optional; mutually exclusive with dsl/type)

ids.description: Fetch multiple assets directly by ID (optional; mutually exclusive with dsl/type)

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return, default 10 (optional)

type.description: Asset type filter: root_domain|ip|subdomain|app|service|endpoint (an independent field that can be combined with dsl; type on its own is not enough to run a query, so dsl is still required)

description:
Search the asset store using simple keyword query q, DSL expression dsl, or direct id/ids lookup, with optional pagination.
DSL syntax: field=value (fuzzy ILIKE) | field==value (exact) | field!=value (exclude) | port>80 (numeric comparison) | bare word (full-text fuzzy).
Logical operators: AND / OR (case-insensitive; AND binds tighter than OR), parentheses for grouping.
Use the separate type parameter to filter by asset type (type is not a DSL field).
Constraint: when id/ids are omitted, at least one filter (q, dsl, company_id, or task_id) must be provided; unconditional queries of all assets are rejected.
Fields:
  domain      Domain name (root domain / subdomain / service host)
  root_domain Root domain name (subdomains / services)
  ip          IPv4/IPv6 address
  url         Full URL (service / endpoint)
  page_title  Page title (HTTP services)
  icp         ICP registration number (root domain)
  service_name Service name (non-HTTP services)
  app_name    Application name (app assets)
  method      HTTP method (endpoint assets, e.g. GET/POST)
  service_type Service type: http|other
  record_type DNS record type (subdomain assets, e.g. A/CNAME)
  technology  Fingerprint / technology stack (= fuzzy, == exact)
  port        Port number (integer; supports > >= < <=)
  status_code HTTP status code (integer; supports > >= < <=)
  company_id  Owning company ID (integer)
  task_id     Source task ID (integer)
Examples: q="10.129.205.13"
          dsl="status_code>=400 AND technology=shiro"
          dsl="method==POST AND url=/api/admin"
          dsl="(port==80 OR port==443) AND technology=nginx"

dsl.description: DSL query expression; see the tool description. Required when neither q nor id/ids/company_id/task_id is supplied. Example: status_code>=400 technology=shiro / method==POST url=/api/admin

id.description: Fetch a single asset directly by ID (optional; mutually exclusive with dsl/q/type)

ids.description: Fetch multiple assets directly by ID (optional; mutually exclusive with dsl/q/type)

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return, default 10 (optional)

q.description: Simple keyword or IP/domain search query (alias for dsl full-text search; e.g. '10.129.205.13' or 'bedside').

type.description: Asset type filter: root_domain|ip|subdomain|app|service|endpoint (can be combined with q or dsl)
